# Erik

> Personal site of Erik, co-founder of Fluencify (https://fluencify.io), based in New York.

## Who

- Name: Erik
- Work: Co-founder of Fluencify, with Sam and Isaac. Fluencify helps brands find out what content to make, gets it produced and published through 20,000+ creators, and analyses the results. Backed by byFounders, Wave and angels. Hiring: https://fluencify.io/labs/careers
- Before: creator (900k+ followers on Instagram); co-founder of BrandPlant (2021–2024, exited).
- Education: Stockholm School of Economics (BSc Business & Economics), KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Engineering Mathematics).
- Contact: erik@fluencify.io
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/erik-romdhane-2149961b7/
- GitHub: https://github.com/erikerkan
